examples.ar: الوَقْتُ كَالسَّيْفِ إِنْ لَمْ تَقْطَعْهُ قَطَعَكَ.
examples.en: Time is like a sword; if you do not cut it, it cuts you.

examples.ar: حُبُّ الوَطَنِ غَرِيزَةٌ مَزْرُوعَةٌ فِي نُفُوسِ البَشَرِ الصَّالِحِينَ.
examples.en: Love of the homeland is an instinct planted in the souls of righteous humans.

examples.ar: الوَفَاءُ بِالعَهْدِ صِفَةٌ تُمَيِّزُ الأَصْدِقَاءَ الحَقِيقِيِّينَ.
examples.en: Fulfillment of covenant is a trait distinguishing true friends.

translation: roses, flowers, watering place, daily devotion

examples.ar: تَفُوحُ رَائِحَةُ الوَرْدِ فَتَمْلَأُ الرِّيفَ بَهْجَةً وَعَطِرًا.
examples.en: The scent of roses wafts, filling the countryside with joy and fragrance.

examples.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ الرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّا.
examples.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.

examples.ar: تَمَيَّزَتْ خُطْبَةُ الأَمِيرِ بِوُضُوحٍ بَلِيغٍ وَإِيجَازٍ مُمَيَّزٍ.
examples.en: The prince's speech was characterized by eloquent clarity and distinct brevity.
